name: Serato
desc: Serato is a New Zealand–founded audio software company best known for its industry-leading DJ and music production tools. Its products power performances in clubs, festivals, and studios worldwide, combining intuitive design with powerful technology for professional and aspiring artists alike.

name: Atlassian
desc: Atlassian is a global software company that builds collaboration and productivity tools for teams. Known for products like Jira and Confluence, Atlassian helps engineers, designers, and businesses plan, track, and ship projects efficiently at scale across organizations.

name: IMC
desc: IMC is a global proprietary trading firm and market maker that leverages technology, quantitative research, and data-driven strategies to trade financial instruments. By providing liquidity across markets, IMC helps ensure more efficient pricing and smoother market operations worldwide.

name: Optiver
desc: Optiver is an international market maker focused on improving financial markets through technology and research. Using advanced algorithms and quantitative models, Optiver provides liquidity across asset classes while investing heavily in engineering talent and innovation.

name: Sandfield
desc: Sandfield is a New Zealand-based software engineering company that designs and builds custom business software solutions. They specialize in solving complex operational challenges, partnering closely with clients to create scalable, high-performance systems tailored to unique industry needs.

name: Visa
desc: Visa is a global leader in digital payments, operating one of the world's largest electronic payment networks. It connects consumers, businesses, banks, and governments, enabling secure and reliable transactions across more than 200 countries and territories.

name: Jane Street
desc: Jane Street is a global quantitative trading firm that uses mathematics, technology, and research to trade financial products across markets worldwide. They design sophisticated algorithms, build advanced software systems, and collaborate in small teams to solve complex problems in finance.

name: Partly
desc: Partly is a fast-growing New Zealand technology company building digital infrastructure for the global automotive parts industry. By structuring and connecting fragmented parts data, Partly improves search, compatibility, and supply chain efficiency across manufacturers and distributors worldwide.

name: ERoad
desc: ERoad is a global telematics and transportation technology company specializing in fleet management. Based in New Zealand, it provides real-time GPS tracking, regulatory compliance tools, and safety data. Their platform helps businesses optimize fuel efficiency, monitor driver behavior, and automate tax reporting.
